summary: The head clipping is fixed: on both pumps (F019-F022, F031-F035) the elbows drop out to +-135 and the forearms stand vertical outside the head; the closest forearm vertex stays 1.36 studs from the head centre. Foot penetration is gone (0 frames, worst -0.015). The arms now trail the body by 1-4 frames and the left and right arms are no longer twinned. Three things remain: the feet skate 0.2 studs forward and back in the crouch (present in iteration 0, I missed it), the re-plant left both feet hovering 0.07-0.08 studs during the final settle (F033-F037), and the legs, root and chest still share keys on 6/12/18/30 (overlap 0.595). The fast arm thrust is the source of the accel-spike metrics; it reads as an intended snap, so it is polish only. The clip still ends in the V pose, as the spec asks.

findings.observation: Side view F000 -> F006 -> F012: both planted feet slide forward under the body in the crouch and back again in the burst. Measured in the iter_1 blend, foot centre y goes -0.150 (F000) -> -0.349 (F006) -> -0.150 (F012): 0.2 studs each way in 6 frames. Cause: thigh -35 / knee 60 at F006 puts the ankle 0.9*sin(35) - 0.75*sin(25) = 0.2 studs ahead of the hip. Fix: same knee bend with the thigh at -27 so the ankle stays under the hip (0.9*sin(27) = 0.75*sin(33)), and the foot at -33 to stay flat (-27 + 60 - 33 = 0).

Introduced by the iteration-0 re-plant: LowerTorso.ly was keyed +0.07 at F034 and F036 (curves.png: the purple bump at the end), so both feet lift off the floor with flat soles while the knees are still bent: lowest foot z is +0.038 at F032, +0.066 at F033, +0.078 at F034, +0.074 at F035, +0.071 at F036, +0.053 at F037 (both feet lose contact at F033-F036 per the contact segments). It reads as an unmotivated float in the final settle. Smaller floats of 0.02-0.04 sit at F008-F010 and F020-F022. Every even frame now carries a root key, so a second plant pass corrects those keys exactly instead of inserting new ones.

metrics: lockstep on frames 6, 12, 18 and 30 (8 of 13 bones: both legs, both feet, the root and the chest), overlap_score 0.595. The legs and root have to move together to keep the feet planted, but the chest lean (UpperTorso.rx keys 6/12/16) and twist (ry keys 18/30) change direction on exactly the same frames as the knees, so the spine has no drag behind the hips in the crouch (F006) or the burst (F012). Fix: let the chest follow the hips by one frame.

metrics: 8 accel spikes of 10-15 deg/frame^2 and 4 velocity corners on UpperArm.rz around the thrust (right arm keys 7 -> 13, left 8 -> 14). The arms cover 145 degrees in 6 frames and stop dead at 165 (F012-F014 in the 3/4 view), then reverse into the first pump. The speed suits a cheer; only the start and stop are abrupt. Optional polish: lightly round the thrust without re-timing it.
